pass_condition: Repository, agency, or public source response is entered in the request tracking ledger, including sent date, result, files received, and withholdings/referrals; response type is classified in the response triage sheet.
blocks_if_missing: Keep candidate in current status; do not promote on memory, email summary, or catalog metadata alone.

pass_condition: Repository, collection, series, folder/file title, OA/ID or NAID, and version status are known: signed final, circulated copy, draft, attachment, public fallback, or not located.
blocks_if_missing: Hold or support only. Public URLs, FAS indexes, CIA histories, statutes, and magazine text do not by themselves satisfy this gate.

pass_condition: Date, title, document type, originator/drafter, recipient, meeting time/place if relevant, and attachments/enclosures are known or explicitly unavailable after search.
blocks_if_missing: Keep as locator or MDR target until the document can be described in FRUS source-note form.

pass_condition: Release status is recorded as open, partially open, withdrawn, referred, denied, pending MDR, public fallback, or not located. Withheld tabs and referral status are named.
blocks_if_missing: Do not treat a reachable PDF as complete; classify the candidate as partial, support, or MDR target.

pass_condition: The record shows organization, management, coordination, budget, staffing, authority, oversight, implementation, or source-control machinery.
blocks_if_missing: Use as chronology, source-note support, or editorial context; do not spend a document slot on policy substance alone.

pass_condition: Any affected architecture or fallback rule is recorded: terminal date, intelligence-chapter scope, public fallback use, case-study count, State lot priority, or control-copy rule.
blocks_if_missing: Keep candidate in hold/include-review posture until the decision is recorded.

pass_condition: The source note follows FRUS order and has no unresolved bracketed facts unless a documented search says the fact is unavailable.
blocks_if_missing: Do not mark source-note-ready; leave the row partial/not ready.

pass_condition: Selection status, source-note readiness, request status, and decision consequences all agree across the public site.
blocks_if_missing: Do not publish a status change that leaves contradictory instructions on another workflow page.
